== Biography ==
{{Scotland Sticker}}
Janet was born on 4 January 1736 in Kilbirnie, Ayrshire, Scotland, and was baptised there on 11 January 1736.<ref>Kilbirnie Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), Jannet Glasgow 11 Jan 1736, daughter of Robert Glasgow and Margarat Allan; citing Ref No: 10 / 88, parish 596.</ref> She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-1075|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Allan-4046|Margaret Allan]]. On 2 September 1756 in Kilbirnie, Janet married [[Cochran-9409|William Cochran]], younger of Ladyland.<ref>Kilbirnie Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Banns and Marriages," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), marriage of William Cochran and Janet Glasgow, 2 Sep 1756; citing Ref No: 10 / 138, parish 596.</ref> They had ten children:
#[[Cochran-9410|William Cochran]], baptised 1 May 1757.<ref>Kilbirnie Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), William Cochran 1 May 1757, son of William Cochran and Janet Glasgow; citing Ref No: 10 / 142, parish 596.</ref>
#[[Cochran-9415|Robert Cochran]], baptised 25 January 1759.<ref>Kilbirnie Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), Robert Cochran 25 Jan 1759, son of William Cochran and Janet Glasgow; citing Ref No: 10 / 148, parish 596.</ref>
#[[Cochran-9416|John Cochran]], baptised 16 January 1761,<ref>Kilbirnie Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), John Cochran 16 Jan 1761, son of William Cochran and Janet Glasgow; citing Ref No: 10 / 154, parish 596.</ref> died young.
#[[Cochran-9417|Margaret Cochran]], baptised 25 January 1763.<ref>Kilbirnie Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), Margarat Cochran 25 Jan 1763, daughter of William Cochran and Janet Glasgow; citing Ref No: 10 / 158, parish 596.</ref>
#[[Cochran-9418|Janet Cochran]], baptised 27 January 1765.<ref>Kilbirnie Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), Janet Cochran 27 Jan 1765, daughter of William Cochran and Janet Glasgow; citing Ref No: 10 / 163, parish 596.</ref>
#[[Cochran-9419|Jean Cochran]], born 28 February 1767.<ref>Kilbirnie Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), Jean Cochran 2 Mar 1767, daughter of William Cochran and Janet Glasgow; citing Ref No: 10 / 168, parish 596.</ref>
#[[Cochran-9420|James Cochran]], baptised 21 March 1769,<ref>Kilbirnie Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), James Cochran 21 Mar 1769, son of William Cochran and Janet Glasgow; citing Ref No: 10 / 171, parish 596.</ref> died in infancy.
#[[Cochran-9421|James Cochran]], baptised 8 May 1771.<ref>Kilbirnie Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), James Cochran 8 May 1771, son of William Cochran and Janet Glasgow; citing Ref No: 10 / 175, parish 596.</ref>
#[[Cochran-9422|Ann Cochran]], baptised 8 June 1773.<ref>Kilbirnie Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), Ann Cochran 8 Jun 1773, daughter of William Cochran and Janet Glasgow; citing Ref No: 10 / 180, parish 596.</ref>
#[[Cochran-9423|John Cochran]], baptised 30 January 1779.<ref>Kilbirnie Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Births and Baptisms," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), John Cochran 30 Jan 1779, son of William Cochran and Janet Glasgow; citing Ref No: 10 / 192, parish 596.</ref>
Janet passed away in Kilbirnie on 23 April 1815.<ref>Kilbirnie Parish, Church of Scotland, "Old Parish Registers Deaths and Burials," database with images, National Records of Scotland ([https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk ScotlandsPeople] : image accessed 13 May 2026), death of Janet Glasgow, relict of Wm Cochran, 23 Apr 1815; citing Ref No: 10 / 365, parish 596.</ref>
